CROSS-REFERENCE — provenance. This removal came out of the 2026-08-12 deprecation removal-readiness survey, which was originally written up on the LLM-gate cost-analysis ticket childsafe-bizarre-lorikeet (comment 11) — a scratchpad placement the operator has since ruled an anti-pattern. The survey summary now lives in session log cosey-vinegarish-mouflon (d0d8-9dfe-f2d8-4364), entry 2.

What the survey said about this item: the ONLY Tier-1 "ready to remove now, no policy conflict" finding of the whole audit. The retired .gitattributes migration arm (src/rebar/_commands/init.py:600-616 plus _RETIRED_GITATTRIBUTES_LINES at init.py:69), introduced bbfa1c1d9b (2026-07-05). This store had already run it — git log origin/tickets -- .gitattributes shows exactly two commits, the second being 826d5ae379 "drop retired .reconciler-* merge=ours", and the live blob contains only ".bridge_state/* merge=ours". ~15 LOC, one file, permanently unreachable here; the only residual risk noted was a clone that had not swept since 2026-07-05.
